acceptance_standard.promising_attribution_gate: failed bucket has >=20 trades, negative aggregate PnL, negative PnL in at least two windows, and worse average PnL than non-failed trades
acceptance_standard.reason: The tested field is known after entry, so this run can only support or reject a follow-on exit/risk experiment.

alpha_hypothesis: Kova-style VCP top-2 breakouts may separate after entry: trades that close back below the inferred breakout pivot during the first three entry/post-entry sessions should explain more tail drag than trades that hold or advance.

backtest_protocol.paper_exit: 10 trading days after signal from exp037

gate3.note: This is post-entry attribution on already selected exp037 paper trades. It cannot reduce core survival or source candidate survival.

gate4.reason: Observed-only post-entry field. A later experiment must test an actionable PIT-safe exit/risk rule before any strategy change.

history_check.exp-20260525-022: Accepted QQQ-confirmed VCP top-1 paper sleeve; source baseline for the VCP paper family.
history_check.exp-20260525-027: Prior pocket-pivot support gate was rejected versus exp022; do not retry pocket-pivot entry support on this sample.
history_check.exp-20260525-030: Event context attribution was useful versus core but weaker than exp022; not a replacement rule.
history_check.exp-20260525-033: Dossier/catalyst attribution did not show catalyst quality as the winning VCP split.
history_check.exp-20260525-036: Late_strong VCP weakness was mostly underparticipation/rank-depth scarcity rather than QQQ gate decay.
history_check.exp-20260525-037: Accepted default-off top-2 VCP paper expansion; this experiment uses its selected trades as the source population.
history_check.exp-20260526-007: Rank-notional profile on top of exp037; this run is a separate post-entry attribution and does not retune capital allocation.

single_causal_variable.advance_definition: no pivot failure and the third observed close is above the signal close
single_causal_variable.failure_definition: any close in the entry-date-inclusive first three trading sessions strictly below the inferred breakout pivot
single_causal_variable.held_definition: no pivot failure but the third observed close is not above the signal close
single_causal_variable.name: post_entry_follow_through_status_3d
single_causal_variable.pivot_definition: breakout pivot inferred as signal close divided by 1 + breakout_above_prior_20d_high_pct from exp037

summary: The first-three-session follow-through split did not produce a stable promotable bucket. Keep exp037 unchanged and avoid adding another post-entry rule on this frozen sample.
